id: \bBill: Hi there. No I'm not a Pokémon, I just got stuck in this costume.
en: \bBill: Hi there. No I'm not a Pokémon, I just got stuck in this costume.
it: \bBill: Ciao. No, non sono un Pokémon, sono solo rimasto incastrato in questo costume.

id: \bBill: Would you mind helping me out?
en: \bBill: Would you mind helping me out?

id: \bBill: Thanks so much! Here, take this item as thanks.
en: \bBill: Thanks so much! Here, take this item as thanks.
it: \bBill: Grazie mille! Ecco, prendi questo strumento come ringraziamento.

id: \bBill: That there is an Old Rod. Use it to catch Pokémon at sea.
en: \bBill: That there is an Old Rod. Use it to catch Pokémon at sea.
it: \bBill: Quello è un Amo Vecchio. Usalo per pescare Pokémon in mare.

id: \bBill: I've been studying here for a long time now, trying to see a rare Pokémon.
en: \bBill: I've been studying here for a long time now, trying to see a rare Pokémon.
it: \bBill: Studio qui da tanto tempo, nella speranza di vedere un Pokémon raro.
